newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's Gloria secures $25 mln CAF loan.
newsitem.headline: Peru's Gloria secures $25 mln CAF loan.

text.p: Peru's leading milk producer, Gloria SA, has secured a $25 million loan from the Andean Development Corp (CAF), the Lima Stock Exchange said Monday.
Gloria has not specified how it will use the loan, but last month the firm said it planned to invest $20 million in building a production plant and distribution center in Lima.
Gloria currently has one plant in the southern city of Arequipa, from which it transports milk 640 miles (1,020 km) to the capital city.
The CAF is the financial arm of the Andean Group, which is made up of Bolivia, Colombia, Ecuador, Peru and Venezuela.
